_comment: Economy settings (systems.md). Every number here is [tune]. pace.time_multiplier scales ALL durations (crafts, station fill time): 1.0 = fast playtest pacing, larger = slower (e.g. 6.0 makes everything six times longer).

progression._comment: Skill 1-100 and XP (#30, professions.md 5). ranks: where each rank starts. Recipe XP per craft and trainer prices are by the recipe's rank (same order as ranks). colours: a recipe learned at skill S gives factor x XP while your skill is below S + below (WoW-style orange, yellow, green, then grey = 0). trade_bonus: extra XP share for recipes that use another guild's goods. first_craft_of_day: XP multiplier for the first finished batch collected each day (UTC). discovery_skill: skill gained the first time you craft a recipe. XP to go from level L to L+1 = xp_base x (1 + L / xp_scale)^2. Every number is [tune].

surprises._comment: Small surprises on collect (#48). rich_find: extra common raw (bonus = rich_find_bonus x what was collected, at least 2). rare_find: 1..rare_find_max of the station's rarer raw. bonus_craft: +1 item per finished batch. The rich-find text is each station's find_label in professions.json.

guild_sale._comment: Sell to guild (#28): instant sale, no listing. Price per unit = reference x max(floor_multiplier, base_multiplier x (1 - drop_per_unit)^pressure). Pressure = units this player sold of this item recently; it halves every recovery_half_life_hours (scaled by pace). Hint shown when the price is below hint_below x base. Keep base_multiplier below market.trader_buy_below so listing pays better.

city._comment: City tab (#38): title shown for the #1 crafter by gold.

trade_offers._comment: Direct trades (#32): the sender's side is held until accepted, declined, cancelled or expired. No fee for now; both sides must contain something (no gifts).

workshop._comment: Bottega levels (0.11.0, #51, docs/palazzo.md). Your skill stops at the top of the rank your bottega allows (25 at level 1, 50 at 2, 75 at 3) and crafts give no XP there until you build the next level (content/professions.json workshop). Players who held a higher rank before 0.11.0 keep it. Per level: craft slots, how much faster crafts finish, and the station's cap and rate multipliers. Every number is [tune].

wanted._comment: The Wanted board at the Palazzo (0.11.0): players post paid requests for goods. The price per unit must sit inside the market band (market.floor_multiplier .. ceiling_multiplier x usual value). The ducats are held when posted; whoever fills it is paid minus the Mercato cut (exchange.cut). Unfilled posts are refunded when they expire or are cancelled. [tune]

palazzo._comment: The Palazzo (0.11.0): each of its three officials gives one small favor per player per day (UTC). A favor asks for goods worth about favor_target_value ducats and pays favor_reward_multiplier x usual value (under the Guild Suppliers' 1.5x, like orders) plus order XP. honor_size: rows on each Hall of honor board. [tune]
